quotes: The South Ukraine Nuclear Power Plant (SUNPP) reported air raid alarms on a near daily basis and detected two drones within its monitoring area late last week.

The Chornobyl Nuclear Power Plant also reported air raid alarms on a near daily basis, with a noticeable increase over the weekend, when the site reported detecting two drones within its monitoring area.
It was the 25th complete loss of off-site power (LOOP) at the ZNPP since the start of the conflict, and the 13th since April.
